title: EnchantMenu
description: EnchantMenu is basically an advanced item editor for Minecraft Fabric 1.21.11. It gives you a GUI-based way to create enchanted, customized, styled, duplicated, and visually modified items without manually writing long commands.
body:
### **EnchantMenu: Overview** ⚡

**EnchantMenu** is a powerful Fabric mod for Minecraft **1.21.11** that turns item customization into a fast, visual, command-free experience. Instead of typing long enchantment or component commands, you get a full in-game GUI where you can edit, enchant, upgrade, style, duplicate, and transform items with just a few clicks.

Built for **creative players, server operators, map makers, datapack creators, and item designers**, EnchantMenu gives you the tools to create everything from clean survival-style gear to completely overpowered **god-tier weapons, armor, and custom showcase items**.

### Command - /enchantmenu 
![Enchant Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce6396123d247a70fc1ab201ad80e1a613bbb300.png)



## **Main Purpose**

EnchantMenu lets you open a custom item editor menu and modify your selected item directly from a GUI.

You can use it to:

- Add and remove enchantments.
- Push enchantments far beyond normal vanilla limits.
- Rename and style items.
- Add lore and rarity effects.
- Modify attributes like damage, speed, health, and resistance.
- Apply armor trims and leather dyes.
- Add potion-style weapon effects.
- Save and load item presets.
- Duplicate finished items instantly.

Whether you are building a custom server kit, testing combat gear, making boss loot, or creating a legendary item for a map, EnchantMenu gives you full creative control.

---

## **How To Open It**

Use this command in-game:

```text
/enchantmenu
```

**You need creative/operator-level permission to use it.**

---

## **Enchantments**

The main menu shows enchantments as clickable enchanted books.

You can:

- **Left-click** to increase an enchantment level.
- **Right-click** to decrease an enchantment level.
- **Shift-left-click** to push an enchantment to a very high level.
- **Shift-right-click** to remove that enchantment.
- Use **Max All Vanilla** to apply normal maximum enchantment levels.
- Use **God Tier Override** to apply extreme high-level enchantments.

This makes it easy to create normal enchanted gear, maxed-out tools, or completely overpowered god items.

---

## **Search And Filters** 🔎

EnchantMenu includes search and filtering tools so you do not have to scroll through everything manually.

Features include:

- Search enchantments by name.
- Show all enchantments.
- Filter combat enchantments.
- Filter tool and utility enchantments.
- Filter armor enchantments.
- Show modded enchantments separately.
- Hide curses.
- Show curses.
- Show only curses.
- Toggle **Universal Mode** to allow enchantments on items that normally cannot accept them.

Universal Mode is especially useful for experimental gear, custom map items, and intentionally broken/fun creations.

---

## **Attribute Editor**

The attribute editor lets you directly change item power and player stats.

You can adjust:

- Attack damage.
- Attack speed.
- Movement speed.
- Max health.
- Knockback resistance.

Normal clicks make small changes, while shift-clicks apply larger changes. This lets you fine-tune balanced items or create ridiculous high-power equipment.

---

## **Name And Lore Styling**

The name and lore tools let you customize how the item looks in the player’s inventory.

You can:

- Set custom preset names.
- Add lore text.
- Clear custom lore.
- Change item rarity.
- Toggle enchantment glow.
- Edit custom model data.
- Hide tooltip details.

This is useful for making legendary weapons, custom RPG items, server rewards, admin tools, or clean hidden-stat items.

---

## **Trim And Dye Tools**

The trim and dye menu focuses on item appearance.

You can:

- Apply armor trim patterns like **Bolt**, **Flow**, **Silence**, and **Spire**.
- Apply trim materials like **Copper**, **Gold**, **Netherite**, and **Redstone**.
- Dye leather armor with preset colors.

This helps you create custom armor sets without needing separate commands or manual item editing.

---

## **Potion And Durability Tools** 🧪

This menu lets you add special utility and combat effects.

You can:

- Set durability to full.
- Set durability very low.
- Toggle unbreakable.
- Add potion-style effects to weapons.
- Make weapons apply effects to targets when attacking.

This is great for custom swords, boss weapons, cursed items, event gear, and experimental PvP tools.

---

## **Preset Manager**

The preset system lets you save and load item setups quickly.

You can:

- **Left-click** a preset slot to save the current item setup.
- **Right-click** a preset slot to load a saved setup.

Presets can store:

- Enchantments.
- Custom names.
- Lore.
- Rarity.
- Custom model data.
- Glow settings.
- Unbreakable state.
- Damage value.

This makes it easier to reuse item designs without rebuilding them from scratch.

---

## **Item Duplicator**

EnchantMenu includes a live item duplicator.

It copies the selected target item into an empty inventory slot, making it easy to duplicate finished gear, test multiple versions, or prepare full item sets.

---

## **Who It Is For**

EnchantMenu is useful for:

- Creative builders.
- Server operators.
- Map makers.
- Datapack creators.
- Modpack testers.
- Custom item designers.
- Admins creating kits or rewards.
- Players experimenting with enchantments and item components.
- Anyone who wants god-tier gear without writing long commands.

---

## **Short Summary**

**EnchantMenu** is an advanced GUI-based item editor for Minecraft Fabric **1.21.11**. It gives you fast access to enchantments, attributes, names, lore, trims, dyes, potion effects, durability tools, presets, and duplication.

It is designed for players who want to create powerful, polished, and highly customized items directly inside Minecraft.

**Open it with:**

```text
/enchantmenu
```

Then choose your item, click your upgrades, and build your perfect weapon, tool, or armor set.
